Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CVX.
We generated $10.7 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2022.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $1.30 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 65 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $4.0 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 3% to 25% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
